title: Regularity of a locally Noetherian scheme tested at closed points
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Then $X$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] if and only if, for every closed point $x\in X$ (meaning $\{x\}$ is closed in the underlying topological space), the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a regular local ring. The empty scheme is allowed.
